notes.title: BladelineVR v0.11 Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Energy shield fixed
[list]

    [*] After energy shield activation, player HP does not decrease, but combo initializes 
        → Combo is not initialized either.

[/list]

[*] Adrestea(Map2), Callisto(Map3) difficulty fixed
[list]

    [*] Slightly increased the number of Mondloids that appear by default.

[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug that the phase was not initialized when forced termination after phase failure.

[*] Fixed a bug that tutorial did not run when running the game first time.

[*]Now those of you who use Oculus Rift can recenter position by pressing 'R'key.  
[/list]

notes.title: BladelineVR v0.1 Released
notes.content:
[h1]BladelineVR  v0.1 Released[/h1]
[list]
[*] Stage1(Metis) difficulty adjustment

[list]
[*] increased number of Mondroids.
[*] decreased number of projectiles.
[*] Mondroids with one bladeline appears in low phases.
[/list]

[*] Score calculation system modified

[list]
[*]High-score method that depends only on combo
 → When the phase increases by 1, each of the Mondroid's base points * 0.05 is added to the base score.

[*]for example)
Base mondroid score 100 points
  Phase1 combo 0 → 100 points added
  Phase1 combo 20 → 100*2 points added

  Phase2 combo 0 → 100+100*0.05 = 105 points added
  Phase2 combo 20 → (100+100*0.05)*2 = 210 points added
[/list]

[*] Mondroid attack speed adjustment

[list]
[*]Mondroids attacked in 0-1 seconds after they approached the player.
 → Mondroids attacked in 0.3-1 seconds after they approached the player.
[/list]

[*] All stage difficulty adjustment

[list]
[*] 2:8 ratio of mondroids with no bladelines and mondroids with one or two bladelines 
  when player reaches to maximum difficulty.

[*] Each ratio of Mondroids in maximum difficulty
  Mondroids with one bladeline 5
  Mondroids with two bladelines 2.5
  Assassins 2.5 
[/list]

[/list]
